confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Yogyakarta price levels for July 2026, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, inexpensive and mid-range meals) are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by location and season. Accommodation anchors assume typical paid nightly rates including the 11% VAT and hotel tax/service where mandatory. Cocktail and wine are weaker, so they are set relative to the beer anchor (roughly 2.5x for cocktail and 3x for wine glass) and are the least certain drink values. The FX observation was taken from an RBA exchange-rates overview excerpt that appeared in search results; I did not open the page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Southeast Asian budget-to-mid-range cities with similar tourism profiles and Indonesian local price levels, such as Chiang Mai and Hanoi, adjusted for Yogyakarta's lower prices than Bali (Ubud/Seminyak) and Jakarta. Accommodation is benchmarked to the Malioboro and Prawirotaman areas where visitors typically stay.
